<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates that break a sulfonamide (functional group “sulfonamides”). This will give a disconnection to a sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid derivative) and an amine, which are both likely commercially available.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
